modulesHelp: Everything Bagel can do in this server. Flip one here, or open it to choose its channel.
needsSetupHint: {n} of these are on but still need a channel or a role. Open the one you want and pick it.
notSetUp: This server has never been set up. Run the fill and Bagel creates the channels and roles it needs.

announcementsLive.name: Go-live posts
announcementsLive.help: One post in your go-live channel when the stream starts, edited when it ends.

announcementsClips.name: Clip posts
announcementsClips.help: Every clip from !clip and from Twitch lands in your clips channel.

welcome.name: Welcome
welcome.help: One embed for each new member. Bagel never DMs joiners.

goodbye.name: Goodbye
goodbye.help: A short line in the same channel when somebody leaves.

voiceHub.name: Join-to-create voice
voiceHub.help: Joining the hub clones a personal room with Lock and Unlock buttons.

logs.name: Staff logs
logs.help: Joins, leaves, edits, deletes and moderation, in one channel.

levels.name: Crumbs and ranks
levels.help: Chat XP with rank and daily cards. Nothing to pick.

linkGuard.name: Link guard
linkGuard.help: Deletes links from members who have no role yet.

subscribers.name: Subscriber tier
subscribers.help: A Subscriber role and its private area, created during setup.

autoRole.name: Automatic roles
autoRole.help: Everyone who joins gets the Member role.

tickets.name: Support tickets
tickets.help: A panel members click to open a private channel with your staff.
